name: Beyond Securities Public Company Limited
summary: Incorporated in 1971 and based in Bangkok, Thailand, Beyond Securities Public Company Limited (formerly AEC Securities Public Company Limited until its rebrand in August 2021) delivers a comprehensive suite of financial services. The firm primarily serves individual and institutional clients throughout Thailand, offering securities brokerage via various trading accounts, including cash, cash balance, and credit balance options. Its diverse service portfolio also encompasses derivatives brokerage, online trading platforms, and extensive investment banking expertise. This includes financial advisory, mergers and acquisitions, initial public offerings, debt structuring and refinancing, real estate investment trust/infrastructure fund services, corporate and capital restructuring. Furthermore, Beyond Securities provides mutual funds, securities borrowing and lending, private fund management, and fixed income products.
